title: Cross-worktree allocation and safe startup
summary: Prevent automatic global planner rewrites and concurrent F/P/T or shortId collisions across worktrees.
description: Current F012 moved transient state to `.planner/.local/` but did not isolate canonical entity writes: `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:39-45`, `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:4213-4223`, and `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts:1032-1040` automatically call global migration/backfill during ordinary load/start. `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1000-1045` stores global F/P/T counters in tracked `project.json`, so two worktrees can allocate the same numbers; `packages/plan-core/src/naming.ts:45-75` has deterministic backfill only, while new entity creation uses local random shortId assignment. Implement a merge-safe design: normal load must not mutate canonical planner entities; explicit maintenance is separately invoked; concurrent ID assignment must be safe across local worktrees and preserve existing UUIDs/shortIds without rewriting unrelated entity files. Add focused regression coverage for no-load-write behavior and concurrent allocation. Preserve `.local/` for transients only and preserve all existing canonical entity content.

tasks.title: Design and implement merge-safe planner allocation
tasks.description:
Implement the approved cross-worktree safety correction in `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`, `packages/plan-core/src/naming.ts`, and startup callers in `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, and `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts`. Existing state: normal startup invokes `migrateToGlobalSequence` and `ensureShortIdsAndPriority`, which can rewrite unrelated canonical planner entities; globally numbered F/P/T allocation persists counters in tracked `project.json`, which duplicates values when branches diverge. Introduce a safe allocator for simultaneous worktrees, make normal loads read-only, retain explicit maintenance paths, and ensure new shortIds are immutable and collision-safe across worktrees. Add regression tests demonstrating separate worktrees/instances do not auto-rewrite unrelated planner files and cannot allocate duplicate F/P/T or shortIds. Do not hand-edit the user’s conflicted planner JSON or resolve their active merge; work only on Agent Plan implementation and isolated temp fixtures.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented cross-worktree allocation and startup safety. `PlanStore.allocateEntityIdentity(kind, entityId)` reserves F/P/T numbers and immutable 5-char short IDs in a lock-protected allocation registry under the shared Git common directory (`.git/agent-plan/allocations/<manifest-projectId>.json`); it never updates tracked `project.json`. Pi, MCP, and HTTP creation paths now reserve number+shortId together before persisting the owned entity. Removed automatic `migrateToGlobalSequence`/`ensureShortIdsAndPriority` from MCP store loading, Pi session init, and web server startup; ordinary `loadManifest`/`loadAll` no longer rewrites `.planner/.gitignore` or bootstraps local timestamp state. Global repair/backfill stays explicit. Added regression coverage for read-only ordinary loads and atomic multi-instance allocation without project counter mutation; adjusted server expectation to global T numbering.

Validation: `pnpm test` (360/360), targeted core regression suite, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test:matrix`, and `git diff --check` all pass. Note: same-clone worktrees are protected by the common Git-dir registry; independent clones/machines need a future shared allocator service to guarantee coordinated human-number allocation.
